title: SEBI Report: Unclaimed Mutual Fund Amounts Reach ₹3,811 Crore as of March 2026
summary: Unclaimed mutual fund dividends rose 15.7% to ₹2,689 crore, bringing total unclaimed MF pool to ₹3,811 crore.

blocks.content: Unclaimed mutual fund dividends rose 15.7% to ₹2,689 crore, bringing total unclaimed MF pool to ₹3,811 crore.

items: **Unclaimed Breakdown:** Unclaimed dividends rose 15.7% to **₹2,689 crore**; unclaimed redemption fell 0.5% to **₹1,122 crore**.
**Total Unclaimed Pool:** Stood at **₹3,811 crore** as of March 31, 2026.
**Remedial Measures:** Centralised nominee reporting with KRA, DigiLocker access, and 'Niveshak Shivir' drive by SEBI + IEPFA.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: IEPFA: Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority under Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Direction Trap:** Unclaimed dividends INCREASED by 15.7%, whereas unclaimed redemption DECREASED by 0.5%.
